caseNameFull: Cavanaugh, Executive Director, South Carolina Department of Probation, Parole, and Pardon Services v. Roller

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 508 U. S. 939.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that W. Gaston Fairey, Esq., of Columbia, S. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
